title: Domain
description: A publisher-scoped subject area. Canonical vocabulary references, when present, must be unique across the domain registry.

id.description: Stable logical identity of this domain.

key.description: Qualified key used by publisher and domain views.

publisher.description: Publisher key that qualifies the domain.

sourceModuleRef.description: Optional IRI for the specific source module.

vocabularyRef.description: Optional canonical vocabulary IRI. When present, only one Domain can claim it.
